findings.transcript_evidence: Very important: if you get numbness around your bottom or genitals, difficulty passing urine, loss of control of your bladder or bowels, or weakness in both legs, go to A&E straight away. That could be a rare emergency called cauda equina syndrome.
findings.rationale: The note fails to document the critical safety-netting advice regarding cauda equina syndrome symptoms, which is a serious safety fact.
